rows.commentary: 0.1: Xavier Bartlett drops it short, Tom Banton rides the bounce expertly on the back foot to nudge it into the mid-wicket region.
0.2: Xavier Bartlett finds immediate away-swing on a full length, allowing Tom Banton to comfortably shoulder arms outside off.
0.3: Xavier Bartlett delivers a rising back-of-a-length ball outside off, which Tom Banton pushes firmly toward cover to get off the mark with a single.
0.4: Xavier Bartlett slides one down leg into the pads, Ben Duckett misses his flick, and Tom Banton is promptly sent back.
0.5: Xavier Bartlett strays down leg once more, letting Ben Duckett glance it away cleanly toward deep backward square-leg for a single.
0.6: Xavier Bartlett digs it back of a length down leg, Tom Banton tucks it wide of square leg, and Carey chases hard to restrict them to one.
1.1: Spencer Johnson hits a tight good length on off stump, anchoring Tom Banton onto the front foot to block it straight back.
1.2: Spencer Johnson bangs it back of a length down leg, glancing off Tom Banton's thigh pad to race down to fine-leg for two leg-byes.
1.3: Spencer Johnson angles a rising delivery into the thigh pad, sliding down leg as Tom Banton fails to connect with his flick.
1.4: Spencer Johnson spears a late inswinger full into Tom Banton, who jams his bat down to flick it behind square where Beardman saves a certain boundary with a stunning dive.
1.5: Spencer Johnson crashes full down leg with sharp inswing, rapping Tom Banton on the pad for a hopeful lbw shout that Marsh rightly ignores as it slides past.
1.6: Spencer Johnson gets this full delivery to shape away outside off, inviting Ben Duckett into a crisp drive straight to mid-off.
2.1: Xavier Bartlett lands a full outswinger outside off at 128kph, and Tom Banton watches it shape away, offering no stroke.
13.1: Cooper Connolly loops it full down leg, Joe Root sweeps firmly, and Head's desperate right-handed dive at backward square leg goes begging as three runs are leaked.
13.2: Cooper Connolly drops it on a length outside off, allowing Ben Duckett to rock back and cut powerfully wide of deep point for a couple.
13.3: Cooper Connolly tosses it full and inviting outside off, and Ben Duckett strides forward to dead-bat it straight back to the bowler.
13.4: Cooper Connolly angles one short and flat outside off, Ben Duckett creates room on the back foot, only to squeeze a thick under-edge away to his left.
13.5: Cooper Connolly fires it short into middle, Duckett pulls straight to the deep square leg fielder to bring up his fifty in style.
13.6: Cooper Connolly serves up another full toss outside off, and Joe Root gets well forward to push it neatly toward cover.
14.1: Matt Renshaw lands a good length delivery that drifts into middle and leg, comfortably knocked by Ben Duckett toward mid-wicket.
14.2: Matt Renshaw flights a flat, good length ball on middle, and Ben Duckett clears room on the back foot to punch it down to long-off.
14.3: Matt Renshaw comes from round the wicket with a tossed-up full delivery on middle, clipped away cleanly by Joe Root to mid-wicket.
14.4: Matt Renshaw strikes as Root dances down, gets too close to the pitch, and watches the full ball sneak underneath his bat to shatter the stumps.
14.5: Matt Renshaw finds the edge off Harry Brook's bat, squirting the ball away toward third man for a single.
14.6: Matt Renshaw angles one into the stumps from round the wicket, solidly blocked back to the bowler by Ben Duckett.
15.1: Mahli Beardman pitches it right up to Harry Brook, who drills it straight back, inviting a sharp reflex block from the bowler in his follow-through.
15.2: Mahli Beardman digs it in short outside off, allowing Harry Brook to rock onto the back foot and dispatch the ball with searing power into the deep mid-wicket fence for four.
15.3: Mahli Beardman targets a good length in the channel, and Harry Brook sits deep in his crease to deftly guide a single down to third man.
29.2: Cooper Connolly serves a very full delivery on off that Ben Duckett drives straight into the hands of mid-off without any timing.
29.3: Cooper Connolly pushes it full outside leg, allowing Ben Duckett to step forward and flick it away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
29.4: Bowling from round the wicket, Cooper Connolly delivers a full ball on off which Jofra Archer flicks toward short fine before abruptly sending Ben Duckett back.
29.5: Cooper Connolly fires it full and wide outside off, forcing Jofra Archer to drop low for a sweep that takes a thick under-edge wide of short fine for a single.
29.6: Cooper Connolly drifts a slower one down the leg side past a sweeping Ben Duckett, neatly gathered by Josh Inglis for a wide.
29.6: Cooper Connolly drops a full one onto leg-stump, and Ben Duckett moves forward neatly to flick it out to deep square leg for a single.
30.1: Matt Renshaw flights a tossed-up full delivery on off, which Ben Duckett steps forward to push solidly toward the cover region.
30.2: Matt Renshaw offers a slower, flighted delivery outside off that Ben Duckett ruthlessly bashes straight down the ground to clear the ropes for six.
30.3: Matt Renshaw bowls fullish on middle, and Ben Duckett advances forward, creates room, and drills a drive wide of extra-cover.
30.4: Matt Renshaw delivers a flat, good-length ball outside off, allowing Jofra Archer to rock onto the back foot and flat-bat it toward mid-off.
30.5: Matt Renshaw floats a full delivery outside off, and Ben Duckett steps forward to smash it hard straight to the fielder at deep extra-cover.

30.6: Operating from round the wicket, Matt Renshaw traps Jofra Archer on the right leg after a missed reverse-sweep, but umpire Sharfuddoula Saikat correctly turns down the optimistic LBW appeal as the ball drifts past off-stump.
31.1: Cooper Connolly loops it too full and wide, allowing Ben Duckett to stride forward and hammer a fierce drive through the covers to reach ninety-six.
31.2: Cooper Connolly slows this full delivery into middle, where Ben Duckett presses forward to push it toward mid-off.
31.3: Cooper Connolly attacks the stumps from a good length outside leg, and Ben Duckett moves back to tuck it toward deep backward square-leg.
31.4: Cooper Connolly tosses up full on middle, and Jofra Archer drops low to sweep it past backward square leg all the way to the short boundary.
31.5: Cooper Connolly fires it full outside off, prompting Jofra Archer to back away and loft an off-balance stroke down to long-on.
31.6: Cooper Connolly extracts extra bounce from a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, forcing Ben Duckett onto the back foot to punch toward extra-cover.
32.1: Travis Head traps Jofra Archer as the batter mistimes a slog-sweep straight to Jack Edwards stationed at deep midwicket.
43.1: Xavier Bartlett offers width outside off, and Will Jacks strides forward to punch on the rise through extra-cover for a comfortable couple.
43.2: Xavier Bartlett pushes it very full outside off, allowing Will Jacks to get forward and ease the drive out to sweeper cover.
43.3: Xavier Bartlett pitches full on middle, and Sam Curran unleashes his signature heave wide of deep mid-wicket, clearing the desperate fielder as it bounces over the rope.
43.4: Xavier Bartlett slips across an off-pace short delivery that beats Sam Curran's early pull, eluding a sloppy Josh Inglis on the half-volley to gift a bye.
43.5: Xavier Bartlett unfurls a back-of-the-hand slower ball outside off, forcing Will Jacks to adjust into a mistimed reverse-sweep toward short third man.
43.6: Xavier Bartlett misses his yorker length with a low full-toss on middle, punched down to long-on by Sam Curran for a single.
44.1: Jack Edwards drops it full just outside off, and Sam Curran pushes the drive straight back down the pitch to the bowler.
44.2: Jack Edwards attacks the tramlines with a wide yorker, catching Sam Curran's inside edge as the ball scurries past leg-stump.
44.3: Will Jacks steps down the pitch to meet Jack Edwards' slower delivery, angling the ball away toward deep backward square leg for a single.
44.4: Jack Edwards digs in a slower-ball bouncer that forces Sam Curran into a mistimed pull straight to substitute Liam Scott waiting at deep square leg.
44.5: Jack Edwards targets a short-of-length spot just outside off, which Gus Atkinson steps back to punch cleanly out to long-off.
44.6: Jack Edwards angles a full slower ball wide from round the wicket, driven firmly past long-off to hustle back for a sharp second run.
45.1: Xavier Bartlett drops a wide low full-toss outside off that Gus Atkinson misses on the glide, drawing an appeal from Josh Inglis that quickly dies as the bump-ball is realized.
45.2: Xavier Bartlett digs it in short outside off, and Gus Atkinson pounces from the back foot to launch a fierce pull clean over the deep square leg fence.
45.3: Xavier Bartlett pushes the delivery full and wide past the tramline, allowing Gus Atkinson to comfortably watch it sail through.
45.3: Xavier Bartlett tries a slower short ball outside off, but it drifts far wide of the tramline again for another extras call as Gus Atkinson ignores it.
45.3: Xavier Bartlett delivers to Gus Atkinson, who works it away into the backward square leg region to comfortably pick up two runs.
0.4: Gus Atkinson strikes immediately as Travis Head attempts a crouched, manufactured cut, nicking a scrambled seam delivery straight into the safe hands of Joe Root at first slip.
0.5: Gus Atkinson pins Matt Renshaw with a sharp, short of a length delivery that nips back inward, leaving the batter grasping at thin air after playing inside the line.
0.6: Gus Atkinson attacks with a sound good length delivery that Matt Renshaw confidently covers and defends.
1.1: Sonny Baker fizzes one wide of off as Mitchell Marsh tries to squeeze it past point, the bat scraping the turf amidst a chaotic fumble from Jordan Cox.
1.2: Sonny Baker offers a tempting outswinger outside off, but Mitchell Marsh lifts his bat high and watches it sail harmlessly through.
1.3: Sonny Baker targets a full length outside off stump, allowing Mitchell Marsh to push a firm drive straight out toward mid-off.
1.4: Sonny Baker claims Mitchell Marsh with a gorgeous away-swinger that catches a thick edge off a hard-handed drive, soaring cleanly into Harry Brook's reverse cup at second slip.
1.5: Sonny Baker whips in a vicious inswinger, but Josh Inglis smartly covers his stumps and lets the movement take it by.
1.6: Sonny Baker angles a fullish delivery across the right-hander, watching as Josh Inglis calmly allows it to drift away.
2.1: Gus Atkinson attacks from round the wicket with a fullish offering outside off, watched closely by Matt Renshaw as it passes.
2.2: Gus Atkinson digs one in on a shorter length, eliciting zero interest from Matt Renshaw.
2.3: Gus Atkinson drifts closer to the stumps with a lively short of a length ball, comfortably blocked from the crease by a watchful Matt Renshaw.
2.4: Gus Atkinson spears this full delivery back sharply off the seam, forcing Matt Renshaw into a precarious leave that misses off-stump by a coat of paint.
2.5: Gus Atkinson attacks the channel at one hundred and forty-two clicks, catching Matt Renshaw's bat as he softly dabs it toward backward point.
2.6: Gus Atkinson strays slightly in line and Matt Renshaw punishes him with a sublime wristy flick, holding his pose as the ball races away for four.
12.5: Will Jacks loops it high through the air, and Matt Renshaw presses forward only to miscue his drive straight toward mid-on.
12.6: Will Jacks floats a full delivery onto middle, allowing Matt Renshaw to punch it cleanly down to long-off where Atkinson restricts them to a single.
13.1: Jofra Archer digs one in short and sliding down leg, prompting Matt Renshaw to tickle it around toward fine-leg.
13.2: Jofra Archer attacks the stumps with a back-of-a-length delivery, forcing Alex Carey onto the back foot to solidly block it back down the pitch.
13.3: Jofra Archer bangs it in on a length around middle, and Alex Carey shifts backward to work it into the deep backward square-leg region.
13.4: Jofra Archer hits a good length on off stump, inviting Matt Renshaw to step forward and scramble a quick single in front of cover.
13.5: Jofra Archer pushes a fuller ball up outside off, and Alex Carey strides forward to stroke his drive out to sweeper cover.
13.6: Jofra Archer targets the middle and leg corridor on a short of length, where Matt Renshaw drops back to glance it toward deep backward square-leg.
14.1: Will Jacks offers a touch of width, and Matt Renshaw rocks back to hammer a fierce pull straight out to deep mid-wicket.
14.2: Will Jacks drifts one wide of off stump, prompting Alex Carey to punch it crisply through the cover region for a comfortable run.

14.3: Will Jacks drifts one in on a good length outside the off stump, prompting Matt Renshaw onto the back foot to unleash a ferocious cut that flashes wide of extra-cover and races away to the boundary.
14.4: Will Jacks keeps it flat and on a good length, and Matt Renshaw stays back to nudge the ball into the mid-wicket sector.
14.5: Will Jacks delivers a full‑on leg‑stump; Renshaw forwards, drives it to mid‑on, no runs.
14.6: Jacks bowls a full‑on leg‑stump; Renshaw flicks forward to deep square leg for a single.
15.1: Archer bowls a short‑of‑length middle‑line; Renshaw backs off, nudges to in front of mid‑wicket for a quick single.
15.2: Archer unleashes a 145.5 kph short‑leg bouncer; Carey ducks, ball passes keeper.
15.3: Archer delivers a back‑of‑length outside‑off; Carey backs up, cuts to sweeper cover for a run.
15.4: Archer bowls a 145 kph short‑leg; Renshaw flicks to fine‑leg for a single.
15.5: Archer sends a steep back‑of‑length; Carey swats cross‑bat to deep square leg for a single.
26.5: Gus Atkinson targets a short-of-length spot outside off, allowing Cooper Connolly to neatly tap it away toward point for a single.
26.6: Gus Atkinson fires in a vicious bouncer that clatters into Cameron Green's grille, drawing blood from the mouth and forcing the shaken batsman to walk off.
27.1: Liam Dawson spears in a flatter delivery, easily blocked into the pitch by Cooper Connolly.
27.2: Liam Dawson offers a fuller length, and Cooper Connolly nudges it smoothly into the off-side for a quick single.
27.3: Liam Dawson pushes it through full, comfortably dead-batted straight back at the bowler by Jack Edwards.
27.4: Liam Dawson drops one in full, neatly worked away through the mid-wicket region by Jack Edwards for a single.
27.5: Liam Dawson angles a full delivery outside the tramlines, where Cooper Connolly pushes firmly toward cover.
27.6: Liam Dawson slides through a quicker delivery, patted softly back down the pitch by Cooper Connolly.
28.1: Joe Root floats a full delivery up to the bat, and Jack Edwards drives it securely toward mid-off.
28.2: Hesitation grips the crease before Joe Root tempts Cooper Connolly into scurrying two as Archer watches from point.
28.3: Root tosses it up outside off and Connolly punches firmly toward sweeper cover for a single.
28.4: Root floats this one onto the stumps and Jack Edwards rotates it smoothly out toward long-on.
28.5: Root strays down leg, allowing Connolly to tickle it through square leg before shouting down any thought of a second run.
28.6: Root offers another regulation delivery that Edwards nudges away cleanly for a quick single.
29.1: Liam Dawson keeps it flat from round the wicket and Edwards works the ball securely into the leg side.
29.2: Dawson attacks the leg stump, forcing Edwards to clip it away toward the deep mid-wicket fielder.
29.3: Dawson serves up a full length that Connolly drives powerfully down the turf toward long-on.
29.4: Dawson fires a slider into the leg stump which Edwards drops down with a straight bat to stifle the danger.
39.6: Liam Dawson flights one on off stump, and Spencer Johnson hangs back to punch it straight back to the bowler.
40.1: Sonny Baker digs in a sharp bouncer that sails far over Mahli Beardman's head, drawing an immediate wide signal from the umpire.
40.1: Sonny Baker drops it on a good length outside off, allowing Mahli Beardman to steer it past backward point for a single.
40.2: Sonny Baker delivers a short-of-a-length ball angling into the left-hander, and Spencer Johnson hacks it away through mid-wicket for a run.
40.3: Sonny Baker attacks with a fuller length on middle, and Mahli Beardman gets right behind the line to block it into the off-side.
40.4: Sonny Baker targets the stumps with a climbing length delivery, forcing Mahli Beardman into an awkward hop to keep it on the ground.
40.5: Sonny Baker bangs it in back of a length at the stumps, and Mahli Beardman nudges it down towards third man for a quick single.
40.6: Sonny Baker angles in a steep short ball that clips off Spencer Johnson's hanging bat and drops safely to the turf as he tries to sway away.
41.1: Liam Dawson tosses one up just outside off, and Mahli Beardman guides it square on the off-side to rotate the strike.
41.2: Liam Dawson floats it on middle and leg, prompting Spencer Johnson to heave it across the line toward mid-on for a single.
41.3: Liam Dawson drifts one away outside off, and Mahli Beardman fires it off the back foot through the gap for a boundary.
41.4: Liam Dawson slides one in with the arm to strike Mahli Beardman on the pad, but the appeal is waved away as it misses leg stump.
41.5: Liam Dawson delivers a slick slider right at the stumps, safely nudged down to long-on by Mahli Beardman.
41.6: Liam Dawson tosses it up, and Mahli Beardman mistimes the lofted stroke wide of mid-on to scamper back for two.
42.1: Sonny Baker angles a short delivery in, catching Spencer Johnson's inside edge as he slogs and misses, the ball trickling past the stumps toward short fine leg.
42.2: Sonny Baker pushes a full delivery through, and Spencer Johnson strokes it cleanly out toward long-off.
42.3: Sonny Baker rolls out a clever slower ball on the stumps, drawing a hard, mistimed swing from Spencer Johnson that yields a single.
42.4: Sonny Baker fires in a sharp, pacy short ball, forcing Mahli Beardman to instinctively duck underneath it.
42.5: Sonny Baker targets a short-of-length spot, and Mahli Beardman hops back to dead-bat it toward short cover.
42.6: Sonny Baker bangs it in, and Mahli Beardman works it away toward third man to pick up a single.
45.6: Gus Atkinson fires in a searing yorker that Mahli Beardman expertly digs out.
46.1: Harry Brook digs one in short, and Spencer Johnson pulls it down to long-on for a single.
46.2: Harry Brook induces a miscued slog from Mahli Beardman, but Banton spills a sitter charging in from mid-wicket.
46.3: Harry Brook fizzes a fast one past the outside edge as Spencer Johnson swings and misses.
46.4: Harry Brook pitches it full, allowing Spencer Johnson to loft it cleanly over mid-off for a boundary.
46.5: Harry Brook darts it rapidly down the leg-side, well gathered by Cox.
46.5: Harry Brook bags his wicket as Spencer Johnson smashes a flat slog straight into the hands of Ben Duckett at deep mid-wicket.

preview.text: Australia and England meet in a one-day match at Bellerive Oval, where they have played 85 recorded one-day meetings with Australia winning 52 and England winning 32. England won the toss and chose to bat first on a ground where the usual first-innings score in the 32 recorded one-day matches is 268. The forecast for the next 8 hours is up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 16 degrees.

summary.text: England won by 97 runs. ENG made 328-10, Ben Duckett top-scoring with 133 off 115 balls; Jack Edwards took 4 for 31. AUS made 231-10, Matt Renshaw top-scoring with 55 off 70 balls; Sonny Baker took 4 for 45. Sides batting first at Bellerive Oval usually make about 268.
